crossRefs.note: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the wood.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Horesh
people.line: A wilderness area where David hid from Saul

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

people.name: Ziph
people.line: A town in Judah where David hid from Saul

translations.web: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the wood.
translations.bsb: While David was in Horesh in the Wilderness of Ziph, he saw that Saul had come out to take his life.
translations.kjv: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
translations.asv: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the wood.
